vision: Design and implement a scalable, event-driven RESTful API for payment processing that supports multiple methods including credit card, ACH, and wire transfers. The API must handle asynchronous workflows, refunds, retries, and fraud reversals while integrating securely with Stripe and Sift to meet PCI-DSS compliance.
scope: The epic covers creation of a FastAPI-based backend with endpoints for payments and refunds, async processing using Kafka events, idempotent gateway interactions, OpenAPI documentation, and PCI-compliant logging. Out of scope are front-end UI components and third-party gateway architecture changes.
success_criteria: API supports all described endpoints with OpenAPI 3.0 documentation.
Payments and refunds processed asynchronously without timeouts.
Integration with Stripe, Sift, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka is validated.
System passes PCI-DSS audit and handles 10,000 payments/day.

user_stories.title: Create and validate payment via POST /payments endpoint with edge case handling
user_stories.i_want: to create a new payment using a selected method and ensure edge cases are handled gracefully
user_stories.so_that: customers can be charged securely, asynchronously, and without duplicate or invalid transactions

acceptance_criteria.given: a valid payment request containing method, amount, currency, and idempotency key
acceptance_criteria.then: a payment record is created, payment event is published to Kafka, and Stripe charge is initiated asynchronously

acceptance_criteria.given: a duplicate idempotency key in a subsequent request
acceptance_criteria.when: POST /payments is called again with same key
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns existing payment status without creating a new charge

acceptance_criteria.given: an invalid payment method unsupported by the gateway
acceptance_criteria.then: API responds with RFC 7807 validation error indicating unsupported method

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment request with negative amount or zero
acceptance_criteria.then: API rejects the request with a validation error explaining incorrect amount

acceptance_criteria.given: a timeout or transient error occurs while communicating with Stripe or Kafka
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns a pending status with retry policy applied and logs event for monitoring

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment request missing required fields such as amount or payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: API responds with RFC 7807 validation details listing missing fields

user_stories.title: Retrieve payment details via GET /payments/{id}
user_stories.i_want: to view current status and metadata of a payment
user_stories.so_that: I can track processing progress and results

acceptance_criteria.then: payment details including status, method, and timestamps are returned following OpenAPI documentation
API returns RFC 7807 compliant error response

user_stories.title: Issue full or partial refund via POST /payments/{id}/refund
user_stories.i_want: to trigger full or partial refund for completed payment
user_stories.so_that: customers can be reimbursed accurately and records reconciled automatically

acceptance_criteria.given: a completed payment and a refund request with amount <= original payment
acceptance_criteria.then: refund transaction is created, event is published to Kafka, and reconciliation job starts automatically

acceptance_criteria.given: a refund amount exceeding original payment
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns RFC 7807 error with validation details

user_stories.title: List payments with filters via GET /payments
user_stories.i_want: to filter and list payments by status and date range
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor transaction volumes and performance

acceptance_criteria.given: valid status and date range query parameters
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns paginated payment list matching filters
API responds with RFC 7807 validation error

user_stories.title: Retry failed payments via POST /payments/{id}/retry
user_stories.i_want: to retry failed payments automatically or manually
user_stories.so_that: temporary gateway or network errors can be resolved without manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.then: system initiates a new payment attempt asynchronously and publishes retry event to Kafka

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment not in failed status
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns RFC 7807 error indicating invalid operation

user_stories.title: Implement rate limiting and PCI-DSS audit logging
user_stories.i_want: to enforce 100 requests/minute per key and log all payment activities
user_stories.so_that: system compliance and performance are maintained under heavy load

acceptance_criteria.given: a client sending multiple requests per minute
acceptance_criteria.then: API responds with 429 Too Many Requests error following RFC 7807 format

acceptance_criteria.given: any payment creation or refund action occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: action is logged for audit with timestamp, user, and PCI field masking
